verdict.rationale: MX runs some work in the background on its own: it automatically re-aggregates each member about every 24 hours (mx-docs-25). Its webhooks push event callbacks to your chosen URL, configurable in the Client Dashboard (mx-docs-7, mx-docs-41). That gives an event-driven foundation you could build automations on, but these are fixed platform behaviors, not automations a user defines. Missing for 10: user-defined automation or workflow builder, custom scheduling or triggers, autonomous agent actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
